title: A Letter for the Bridge
author: Zephyrine Dravenmoor
blurb: Silas Amberdale, a battlefield nurse keeping a ledger of the names officers omit, has spent twelve years learning which silences keep people safe. But when the census taker asks one question too many, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must smuggle the evidence past three checkpoints, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
